Which reactions are redox reactions?
1
the incomplete combustion of propane
2
the rusting of iron
3
the reaction of aqueous chloride ions with acidified aqueous silver nitrate
4
the thermal decomposition of calcium carbonate
A
1 and 2
B
1 and 3
C
2 and 4
D
3 and 4
